newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguayan consumer prices up 2.5 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Uruguayan consumer prices up 2.5 pct in September.

text.p: Uruguayan consumer prices rose 2.50 percent in September 1996, compared with 2.15 percent in August and 1.91 percent in September 1995, the National Statistics Institute said Thursday.
September's inflation brought to 19.48 percent the increase in the first nine months of 1996, compared with 28.10 percent in same period last year.
In the 12 months to September consumer prices grew 26.32 percent, a steep decline from the 42.24 percent rise in the year to September 1995, the Institute said.
Uruguay posted an inflation rate of 35.4 percent in 1995 and expects to end 1996 with a 25.0 percent rate.
